Subject: Quick question on hosted IO rates + supported models for PoC

Hi Connor,

We’re kicking off a small PoC to evaluate LLM-assisted clinical note summarization and would like a baseline on your hosted pricing before we lock in infra for the pilot. Two quick asks: 

- Standard per-1M token rates (input vs output) for hosted API 
- Short list of supported models that you recommend for low-latency summarization (and which of those are available in eu-west-1)

We’re planning ~10k daily users during PoC with an expected 1.5 input tokens per word and 0.9 output tokens per word (rough estimate). Also curious what committed discounts look like at 10M/50M/200M token tiers.

Can you send a basic rate snapshot and model compatibility matrix? Budget owner (procurement@healthq.ai) is CCd.

Thanks,

Hi Stella,

Thanks for the note and contextthis is a great fit for a PoC. High-level answers below to get you moving; I’ll attach our current hosted ratecard and model roster for eu regions in a follow-up.

Baseline hosted (list prices, USD per 1M tokens):
- Input tokens: $0.20 per 1M
- Output tokens: $1.20 per 1M

Model recommendations for low-latency summarization (eu-west-1 availability noted):
- redwood-compact-1 (low-latency, good for short summarization) - available in eu-west-1
- redwood-standard-2 (balanced quality & latency) - available in eu-west-1
- open-mt-slim (cheaper but lower quality for long contexts) - available via BYO mirror in eu region (ask for enable)

Committed discount guidance (approx, applied to total token spend monthly):
- 10M/month: 10% discount
- 50M/month: 18% discount
- 200M+/month: 28% discount + negotiation on billing terms

Quick clarifying Qs that will change recommended config and final pricing:
1) Target avg tokens per call (you estimated words, do you have a sample prompt/response length in tokens?)
2) Do you require EU-only data residency and EU key management?
3) Any SLA or retention/compliance needs (SOC 2/HIPAA) for the PoC?

I’m looping in Lauren (cc) to share the PDF ratecard and the eu model availability sheet. We can also set up a 30-minute call to walk through tradeoffs and sizing.

Best,
Connor O

Connor,

Thanks that helps a lot. A few replies inline: 

- Avg tokens per call: we measured on a representative setapprox 800 input tokens and 220 output tokens per call for the clinical note summarization path.
- Yes, EU-only data residency is required for this PoC (we host in Dublin).
- Compliance: SOC 2 is fine for the PoC; if we expand to production we may need more controls (we'll surface those later).

On discounts: the 18% at 50M looks reasonable. Can you confirm whether those tiers are calendar-month committed minimums or rolling 30-day usage buckets? Also, what lead time do you need to enable eu-only keys and region pinning for a trial account?

If it helps, we’d like a short T&Cs preview for procurement so they can validate billing cadence.

If you can attach the ratecard and a simple model-availability CSV I can forward to procurement.

Cheers,
Stella
